instruction: How many people follow the artist of the currently playing song on Spotify?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are required (evaluation demands no model changes), so every action is read-only. World facts (playing-song, song-artist, artist-follower-count) are static in :init; agent knowledge is tracked by profile-known, passwords-known, has-token, known-current-song, known-id and found-follower-count. show_current_song reveals the artist id of the playing song; show_artist (no token needed) reveals the follower count, which is passed as the answer parameter of supervisor-complete-task (the artist parameter is a non-API task record linking the count to the current song's artist). supervisor is not declared as an app constant since its APIs need no login.
